about: The vaults this site reads or keeps evidence in (SG/Send, encrypted before upload; the server holds ciphertext only). Only READ keys of vaults meant to be read are published here: a read key is derived one-way and cannot write. A vault key is never in this repository, a commit message or a page. Private vaults are listed by id only.

vaults.name: storm-charles-evidence-display
vaults.what: The screenshots and capture summaries the evidence pages show, for sources that may be shown (evidence/sources.json), at <evidence id>/screenshot.jpg, screenshot-clean.jpg and capture.json.

vaults.name: storm-charles-evidence-captures
vaults.what: Every capture in full, by source and date: the HTML as served, the document after scripts, the visible text, the screenshots, the response summary. Packed (objects travel as zips): not readable from the web. Private: no key is published.
